values.name: Absorb Bulb
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   When the holder takes water-type damage from a move, its Special Attack rises by one stage and this item is consumed.

values.name: Binding Band
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   Moves used by the holder that trap and damage a target for multiple turns (e.g. bind, fire spin) inflict twice their usual per-turn damage.

values.name: Bright Powder
values._ingameEffect:
Held in battle
:   Moves targeting the holder have 0.9× chance to hit.

values.name: Cell Battery
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   When the holder takes electric-type damage from a move, its Attack rises by one stage and this item is consumed.

values.name: Destiny Knot
values._ingameEffect: Held: When the holder becomes Attracted, the Pokémon it is Attracted to becomes Attracted back.

values.name: Expert Belt
values._ingameEffect: Held: When the holder hits with a super-effective move, its power is raised by 20%.

values.name: Float Stone
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   Holder has 0.5× weight.

values.name: Grip Claw
values._ingameEffect: Held: Increases the duration of the holder's multiturn (2-5 turn) moves by three turns.

values.name: Luminous Moss
values._ingameEffect: Held: If the holder is hit by a damaging Water move, it consumes this item and raises its Special Defense by one stage.

values.name: Lagging Tail
values._ingameEffect: Held: The holder will go last within its move's priority bracket, regardless of Speed.  If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first.  The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall.  If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored.  This item ignores Trick Room.

values.name: Light Clay
values._ingameEffect: Held: The holder's Reflect and Light Screen will create effects lasting for eight turns rather than five.  As this item affects the move rather than the barrier itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

values.name: Metronome
values._ingameEffect: Held: Each time the holder uses the same move consecutively, its power is increased by another 10% of its original, to a maximum of 100%.

values.name: Protective Pads
values._ingameEffect: Held: Prevents side effects of contact moves used on the holder.

values.name: Red Card
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   When the holder takes damage directly from a move and does not faint, it switches out for another random, non-fainted Pokémon in its party.
This effect does not activate if another effect prevents the holder from switching out.

values.name: Ring Target
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   When one of the user's types would render it immune to damage, that type is ignored for damage calculation.

values.name: Rocky Helmet
values._ingameEffect:
Held
:   When the holder is hit by a contact move, the attacking Pokémon takes 1/6 its max HP in damage.

values.name: Safety Goggles
values._ingameEffect: Held: Prevents damage from powder moves and the damage from Hail and Sandstorm.

values.name: Shed Shell
values._ingameEffect: Held: The holder is unaffected by any moves or abilities that would prevent it from actively leaving battle.

values.name: Snowball
values._ingameEffect: Held: If the holder is hit by a damaging Ice move, raises its Attack by one stage.

values.name: Sticky Barb
values._ingameEffect: Held: Damaged the holder for 1/8 its max HP.  When the holder is struck by a contact move, damages the attacker for 1/8 its max HP; if the attacker is not holding an item, it will take this item.

values.name: Weakness Policy
values._ingameEffect: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.

values.name: Zoom Lens
values._ingameEffect:
Held: Raises the holder's Accuracy by 20% when it goes last.
Ingame description is incorrect.

values.name: Mental Herb
values._ingameEffect:
Held in battle
:   When the holder is attracted, it consumes this item to cure the attraction.

values.name: Power Herb
values._ingameEffect: Held: Whenever the holder uses a move that requires a turn to charge first (Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Razor Wind, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, or Solarbeam), this item is consumed and the charge is skipped.  Skull Bash still provides a Defense boost.

values.name: White Herb
values._ingameEffect:
Held in battle
:   At the end of each turn, if any of the holder's stats have a negative stat modifier, the holder consumes this item to remove the modifiers from those stats.

values.name: Full Incense
values._ingameEffect: Held: The holder will go last within its move's priority bracket, regardless of Speed.  If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first.  The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall.  If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored.  This item ignores Trick Room.

values.name: Lax Incense
values._ingameEffect: Held: Increases the holder's Evasion by 5%.

values.name: Odd Incense
values._ingameEffect: Held: Increases the power of the holder's Psychic moves by 20%.

values.name: Rock Incense
values._ingameEffect: Held: Increases the power of the holder's Rock moves by 20%.

values.name: Sea Incense
values._ingameEffect: Held: Increases the power of the holder's Water moves by 20%.

values.name: Wave Incense
values._ingameEffect: Held: Increases the power of the holder's Water moves by 20%.

values.name: Adrenaline Orb
values._ingameEffect: Makes wild Pokémon more likely to summon allies.  Held: increases the holder's Speed by one stage when affected by Intimidate.

values.name: Iron Ball
values._ingameEffect: Held: Decreases the holder's Speed by 50%.  If the holder is Flying or has Levitate, it takes regular damage from Ground attacks and is suspectible to Spikes and Toxic Spikes.

values.name: Terrain Extender
values._ingameEffect: Held: When the holder changes the Terrain (whether by move or ability), it will last  8 turns instead of 5.

values.name: Electric Seed
values._ingameEffect: Held: If the holder enters battle during Electric Terrain, or if Electric Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder's Defense raises by one stage.

values.name: Grassy Seed
values._ingameEffect: Held: If the holder enters battle during Grassy Terrain, or if Grassy Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder's Defense raises by one stage.

values.name: Misty Seed
values._ingameEffect: Held: If the holder enters battle during Misty Terrain, or if Misty Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder's Special Defense raises by one stage.

values.name: Psychic Seed
values._ingameEffect: Held: If the holder enters battle during Psychic Terrain, or if Psychic Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder's Special Defense raises by one stage.
